reviews.author: Nyree Griffin
reviews.text: I've been bringing my vehicle here for a long time, and I couldn't be happier with the service. The work is always done right, and the team is honest and trustworthy. I really appreciate how they provide a detailed printout showing the work that was performed, the cost of the parts, the labor charges, and any other repairs that may be needed. Their transparency gives me confidence that I'm being treated fairly. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and dependable mechanic!

reviews.author: Eddie Nino
reviews.text: Excellent service and pricing is reasonable for the quality. The front desk lady is awesome, very knowledgeable and juggles so much that I don't think the shop would survive without her! She deserves a raise. Gino is also great, he's patient and takes the time to answer questions. They are certainly my go-to shop for any repairs.

reviews.author: Maria Poisler
reviews.text: Dear Gino and Staff, I wanted to send a sincere thank you for taking such good care of me and my Sienna 2017. As someone who doesn't know much about cars, I truly appreciate your honesty in telling me I needed a water pump instead of a tune-up. After losing my husband Oscar things have been a bit of a challenge, and your understanding means the world to me. It is wonderful to know there are still such good, honest people in business. See you again for many years. Best, Maria Poisler

reviews.author: Gilberto Doran
reviews.text: The staff were very polite and helpful. They're very knowledgeable and respectful. I would recommend them to everyone and shout out to Gino. Super cool guy. I'm definitely going to be coming back for car services.

reviews.author: Orlando Rodriguez
reviews.text: I enjoyed Westside Tire and Automotive. Friendly, professional personnel explained my car's needs. They took care of everything, and my car drives better than it has in a long time. I like their honesty, reliability, and service guarantee. A reliable local business is fantastic. For future maintenance and repairs, I'll return.

reviews.author: Lucas Goodman-Charlton
reviews.text: So let me start off by saying as a person who is a mechanic (commercial equipment not automotive) I do all the work in my own car because the couple times I did take it to other shops it was nothing but hell and more issues this place was great. I do majority of the work myself but sadly I don’t have access to alignment machine or wheel balancer. I tried multiple shops in the past to have my bad vibration resolved but was told the wheels were balanced fine. Westside was finally able to balance them and now I can go over 50mph without it feeling like I’m reentering earth’s atmosphere from space. They didn’t try to push unwarranted repairs or charges (I know there are things that still need work in my car) which was great compared to most shops that tried to upcharge and push other repairs, even repairs on things that I know are fine. So as someone who hates the bs of most automotive shops this was a pleasant and welcomed change of pace. Will definitely be returning.

reviews.author: Michelle Albon
reviews.text: Today I was traveling to visit my son when I hit a pot hole completely blew out my tire. Gino was amazing to reassure me that he would take care of everything and even called my husband back to let him know I made it to the shop. Thank you for helping me and turning a rather stressful day around with your great service!

reviews.author: Justin C
reviews.text: Convenient service, transparent explanations and fair prices. Today I caught a nail on my way to work and they got me back on the road in 20 mins. I’ve been taking my cars here for many years and can definitely recommend their services.

reviews.author: Ezra feldman
reviews.text: Born and raised in JC - this is the shop I can count on. I have an older 2005 Chevy Suburban, they help keep it reliable and on the road. I'm grateful for Gino and sons.

reviews.author: Cara Craig Walker
reviews.text: I trust WestSide Tire and Automotive completely! They have taken care of my family’s cars for 6 years-. I know that I can ask Jo, Gino, and Gino anything about my car and they never make me feel silly.

reviews.author: Santanathedon Ent
reviews.text: I don’t want to go to any dealership or any other mechanic shop after going here , they’re the best hands down, very respectful very professional and took the time to fully diagnose my cars issues something my Mazda dealership couldn’t even do. And then they made sure to leave me professional recommendations and advice 10/10 customer service.

reviews.author: Judith Moss
reviews.text: Checked my flat . Could not repair, but replaced. Also did inspection. Quick and painless service. Pleasant office and staff.

reviews.author: Theral Gibson
reviews.text: I have been using Westside Tire & Automotive for years. The mechanics are very professional courteous and do a great job. I wasn’t sure what the problem was but they found it.

reviews.author: Dennis K
reviews.text: Joe is the best. Great Customer Service. Explains exactly what you are paying for. I always come back.

reviews.author: Jonathan Brooks
reviews.text: Great people and quick service. I came in as a walk-in needing some bent ribs repaired, and they did them instantly while I waited. Really appreciate them.

reviews.author: Nick Arata
reviews.text: Worst customer service I have ever received. Guy with the grey hair is absolutely miserable. They lie and do not listen. I would suggest taking your business elsewhere.

reviews.author: Raul A. Diaz
reviews.text: Trustworthy, and thorough service!! Old school family owned. Came in for a serpentine belt replacement, mechanic found another issue, oil leak from cam seals. I knew engine had several issues and trust their diagnosis. Reasonable standard rates and they are willing to work with you. They don't pressure you. Girl at reception is no nonsense straight up with you, courteous and professional. Finished work was solid, clean and super happy on condition. Thank you!!

reviews.author: John Collins
reviews.text: This is the only place I will go.to get my trucks fixed /maintained etc. The service is great but the people are even better. They always beat any price by a mile too

reviews.author: J [Redacted]
reviews.text: The true wheel bosses of NJ - from ever pleasant Jo at the door, to the skill technicians on the garage floor, Gino & Junior offer the best service my 500 has ever had & keep her purring. Thank you all for keeping FiFi purring

reviews.author: B Blwtn
reviews.text: Went here for road force balance on friday. Im hearing the other guy that the roadforce machine was broken. Im not sure if they really balance my wheels, after the service they stated that my rotors are warped, that’s fine. On my way home no difference on vibrations. I haven’t got a chance to check the wheel because it’s so windy and cold outside that day. The next day (saturday) I checked the wheels, the weights is still the same weights I have and the worst thing checked my lug nuts and saw my stud was broken, it is over torqued, whoever torqued my wheels is unknowledgable, uneducated, brainless. On the invoice stated that “torqued on manufacturers recommendation” hell no.They didn’t even informed me that they broke it. Trying to call them at 2:30pm no one is answering, went to the place it was close already. But the posted closing time was 3pm. I don’t recommend getting service on them. Just go with the dealership or look for other reputable shop.

reviews.author: Chacè Wessley
reviews.text: These guys beat me and my brother out of $800, replaced the bad battery with a half dead battery , as we pulled out the car was worse than when we took it in , Pep boys diagnosis revealed the hustle they ran on us , sad lack of integrity on their behalf.wish I did this review when it happened..

reviews.author: Rüya Yürek
reviews.text: I had my state inspection done here, and the whole process was incredibly smooth. The woman at the front desk was so kind and helpful. It made the experience even better

reviews.author: Greg Corra
reviews.text: I had a crack in my alloy wheel, and they fixed it quickly and for a very reasonable price. I showed up at 8:30 on a busy day and they had me out before noon with my wheel fixed for under $200. The people I dealt with were very pleasant and straight forward. The place was packed with people getting all manner of services and repairs but they never got frazzled or impatient

reviews.author: Larry Newman
reviews.text: Professionals par excellence. I’ve read some bad reviews here, don’t buy it. I came to get my summer tires put back on and had a few rims straightened. This place will assess your car, make a diagnosis, and spell out options. They are neat, organized, and concise. They are not the cheapest place in town but you get what you pay for. I’ve entrusted my new Tesla to them multiple times. They showed me and my ride respect. Long history in the neighborhood with ethical behavior. All their people are focused on the job at hand. Clean bathroom and WiFi to boot, what more could you want. All my best to the Ginos’

reviews.author: William J Kimmerle
reviews.text: By far the most attentive, responsive, and professional automotive professionals I have ever encountered. They dealt with a customized vintage vehicle and took on major repair tasks with great expertise. I cannot recommend enough.

reviews.author: Bharat Upadhyay
reviews.text: I had a flat tire on my new Mercedes AMG GLB 35 this past Saturday and initially took it to Pep Boys and Mavis Tire Discount Store. Both places said they couldn’t repair the tire and insisted on replacing it with a new one, which felt unnecessary because tire is in great condition. Then I called West Side Tire & Automotive, and although they were about to close, they agreed to inspect my tire. I stopped by, and within 20 minutes, they had it repaired perfectly. Unfortunately, the Mercedes hub cap fell off and got scratched after the repair. We are all human and accidental damage can happen, but I’m truly impressed that the West Side Tire & Automotive team took full responsibility and accountability for the damage. They fixed it promptly without any delay. The staff, especially the lady at reception and the technician, were very kind and professional from start to finish. On Monday, I returned and spoke with the owner, Gino Sr., who was incredibly helpful. He personally inspected the tire and approved a replacement hub cap. The receptionist coordinated quickly with the Mercedes dealership to get the original part, and later that day, Gino Jr. replaced it flawlessly. This experience taught me to always support local, small businesses rather than large chains like Pep Boys or Mavis, who seemed more focused on pushing expensive replacements instead of offering a fair repair. I am truly impressed with the exceptional customer service from the entire West Side Tire & Automotive team, the receptionist, the technicians, Gino Sr., and Gino Jr. I will definitely be returning for any future vehicle needs and highly recommend them to everyone in my network!

reviews.author: Andy Woodard
reviews.text: Five star experience! They were able to work on my car right away and replace the tires without any wait. I checked the reviews first and saw all the 1 star reviews at Costco and the horror stories of waiting 3 hours. So I came here instead and not only did they have me in and out in an hour and a half, they also charged about $50 less per tire than the original quote. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Riley Hundley
reviews.text: This shop is extremely professional and provides very transparent service. I brought my 2006 Honda in for an alignment and some new tires and I felt the team went above and beyond to deliver a phenomenal experience. The shop is clean, the staff are well-versed in their automotive knowledge, and they have extensive ASE certifications lining the wall to support their automotive expertise. The communication was clear and I never felt they were trying to upsell me on anything unnecessary, contrary to other shops in the area. I will absolutely be returning for future repairs.

reviews.author: John Robbins
reviews.text: I’ve visited this shop twice for tire-related issues. On both occasions, the woman at the front desk was friendly and professional, which I appreciated. Unfortunately, my experience with Gino Jr. was quite the opposite. He was dismissive, avoided eye contact, and came across with a noticeably poor attitude that made the interactions uncomfortable. Even the front desk associate felt the need to apologize for his behavior, saying, “He’s going to give me gray hairs, I’m sorry for him, he’s not exactly a people person.” While I understand that not everyone is naturally inclined toward customer service, it’s disappointing when someone in a customer-facing role makes you feel unwelcome. Ultimately, I chose to take my business elsewhere. It’s unfortunate, because this shop could be a solid local option if not for that dynamic.

reviews.author: Kit Tang
reviews.text: I had my inspection and repair works several times in Westside tire and auto, services are as great as usual. They are helpful in explaining everything you needed and offered follow up checking for me. The costs are listed clearly on the receipt, transparent for what you have paid. 100% recommend

reviews.author: Sakib Chowdhury
reviews.text: Their work is good. But the women in the front is sometimes rude. I asked about estimates cost for transmission fluid change - she just hung up the call saying she has too many calls to pick.

reviews.author: Manu Mathew
reviews.text: Gino and his team are experts in fixing scratches on my rims. I had scratches on all my 4 rims. They were able to fix it back to the original. Also I had a dent on my car and they were able to fix it flawlessly. I highly recommend their service for your tire and auto needs!

reviews.author: Steven Hazlett
reviews.text: Jo and the team were incredibly helpful the pre-purchase inspection on a private sale. She was kind, caring, and patient and guided us through a difficult decision. We avoided a used car that would have cost us thousands in repairs. So glad we came here, and we will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Yu C
reviews.text: Went to Gino for a 150k tune up and some major repairs. The crew did a fantastic job. Car drives so much better and feels so much nicer. Would definitely recommend anyone to come here. Ask for Gino and he will for sure answer your questions.

reviews.author: Jose A Valencia
reviews.text: I asked Gino what was I signing and he kept saying, please sign the document and I tell you. Not an honest way of doing business.

reviews.author: Tom G
reviews.text: First time here for an inspection. Top shelf service - great, friendly staff who explained everything. My go to mechanic from here on!!

reviews.author: Simone Thomas
reviews.text: I was looking for a nearby place for New Jersey State Inspections and found West Side on Google. My vehicle was seen within 5 minutes of arrival and I was out within 20 minutes. Very expedient and great customer service. Thank you for being convenient and expeditious, West Side!

reviews.author: Linda Santos
reviews.text: This place is great!!!! Their service and the work done is unmatched! I had my tires done here with a wheel alignment and have had friends of mine go here and there were no complaints. Tony is the one who serviced my car and he was Amazing !

reviews.author: Bette S
reviews.text: I was unsure who to use when my car needed repair. A friend suggested West Side Tire & Automotive. They are great. The work was done on time and they gave me a fair price. They didn't try to upsell or do other things to my car. Good honest service what more could I ask for. I highly recommend them. They are my car guys now.

reviews.author: Roberta Nicole
reviews.text: I was in and out for my state inspection. I was treated fairly and with respect. As a female going to any auto mechanic place they are sometimes not as nice and respectful to females and treat them dumb. Not the case here. I did have a guy with me too so idk if that helped lol but nonetheless the service was good and speedy. Thank you.

reviews.author: Paulino Lopez Jr
reviews.text: I needed a NJ car inspection; they were fast, and everyone was friendly. will come back here to do other work on my car when needed.

reviews.author: Sean Millington
reviews.text: I have been a loyal customer for over 10 years....no one else is allowed to touch my 88 Supra. A bit expensive but you get what you pay for...always professional and courteous

reviews.author: Bata Tamad
reviews.text: Brought my car in for tires and an alignment. It ended up needing some additional parts replaced. Tony took care of it all and got my car back to me the same day! Car runs great! Thanks Tony and Westside!

reviews.author: Triece Dykes
reviews.text: I love this place, they always go above and beyond for their customers. I came in the late afternoon to have my car checked, turns out I needed an alternator and battery, because I no longer live in town they had their best guy work on my car. I came in @ 2:30 and left at 5. Thanks you guys for always taking care of me & my car!!

reviews.author: Ahmed. M
reviews.text: Great people and customer service is even better, got my brakes and tie rods done there from a little emergency i had on the highway not too long ago and for how packed shops are the turn around time wasn’t too shabby.

reviews.author: Reiner Delacruz
reviews.text: Service and work are top notch and so were the people, everybody was friendly, helpful and considerate. Will definitely go back and definitely recommend for any automotive services!

reviews.author: Steven P
reviews.text: The staff here was very welcoming and they were all quick to help me out. They even helped me put my spare on. Great service all around!

reviews.text: Awsome service !! Gino Jr serviced my 2004 Infinity I35. diagnostic test done. replaced radiator and thermostat. check engine lght GONE.....JOB WELL DONE...ALSO FOLLOW UP SERVICE REQUESTED NEW TIRES THANKS!! THESE GUYS ARE TRUE CRAFTSMAN....RECOMMEND ANY PERSON TO GET THERE CAR REPAIR AT THIS SHOP.......!!

reviews.text: New to N.J. and needed an out of state emissions inspection. The staff is incredibly friendly and professional. Clean, comfortable waiting area and I’m all around very pleased.

reviews.author: Giovanni Pino

reviews.author: Dan A
reviews.text: Great service, great people, great experience. I needed good tires in little time and Gino Jr. did exactly as he said he would. Highly recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Jose “chamba16” Perez
reviews.text: Great service, people are so kind and willing to fix anything, and the manager is so easy to talk, he tells you the pros and cons. I will go back with my car again

reviews.author: D SHIELDS.

reviews.author: Shawn Smith
reviews.text: Not too many automotive businesses woman can take they car and trust that You are not getting scammed. And a good job done. Thank You, Westside Tire & Automotive.

reviews.author: Eduardo Perez-Tobon

reviews.text: Definitely recommend this place To anyone, very professional, excellent employees, excellent job. My jeep feels brand new. Thanks to all.

reviews.author: Dominick Barile

reviews.author: Ted Jensen

reviews.author: Henna K.

reviews.author: Paul Mastin
